import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = 1000000007L;
    static final int MAX_NODE = 5005;
    static final int MAX_TIME = 100;

    static class Edge {
        int from;
        int to;
        long capacity;
        long flow;
        long cost;

        Edge(int from, int to, long capacity, long flow, long cost) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static class MCMF {
        int nodes;
        List<Integer>[] adj;
        List<Edge> edges;
        long[] distance;
        boolean[] inqueue;
        int[] prev_edge_index;
        long[] min_flow_on_path;

        MCMF(int n) {
            this.nodes = n;
            adj = new List[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
            distance = new long[n];
            inqueue = new boolean[n];
            prev_edge_index = new int[n];
            min_flow_on_path = new long[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap, long cst) {
            edges.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, 0, cst));
            edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, -cst));
            int idx = edges.size() - 2;
            adj[u].add(idx);
            adj[v].add(idx + 1);
        }

        boolean computePath(long[] flow_on_this_path, long[] cost_per_flow) {
            Arrays.fill(distance, INF);
            Arrays.fill(inqueue, false);
            Arrays.fill(prev_edge_index, -1);

            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(0);
            distance[0] = 0;
            inqueue[0] = true;
            min_flow_on_path[0] = INF;

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                inqueue[u] = false;

                for (int eidx : adj[u]) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(eidx);
                    if (e.capacity > e.flow && distance[e.to] > distance[u] + e.cost) {
                        distance[e.to] = distance[u] + e.cost;
                        prev_edge_index[e.to] = eidx;
                        min_flow_on_path[e.to] = Math.min(min_flow_on_path[u], e.capacity - e.flow);
                        if (!inqueue[e.to]) {
                            q.offer(e.to);
                            inqueue[e.to] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (distance[1] == INF) {
                return false;
            }

            flow_on_this_path[0] = min_flow_on_path[1];
            cost_per_flow[0] = distance[1];
            int cur = 1;
            while (cur != 0) {
                int eidx = prev_edge_index[cur];
                edges.get(eidx).flow += flow_on_this_path[0];
                edges.get(eidx ^ 1).flow -= flow_on_this_path[0];
                cur = edges.get(eidx).from;
            }
            return true;
        }

        long[] getMinCostFlow(int src, int dst) {
            int original_nodes = nodes;
            nodes = original_nodes;

            int old_src = 0, old_dst = 1;
            for (Edge e : edges) {
                e.from = (e.from == 0 ? src : (e.from == 1 ? dst : e.from));
                e.to = (e.to == 0 ? src : (e.to == 1 ? dst : e.to));
            }

            long total_flow = 0, total_cost = 0;
            long[] flow = new long[1];
            long[] cost = new long[1];

            while (computePath(flow, cost)) {
                total_flow += flow[0];
                total_cost += flow[0] * cost[0];
            }

            return new long[]{total_flow, total_cost};
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner cin = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = cin.nextInt();
        int m = cin.nextInt();
        int k = cin.nextInt();
        int C = cin.nextInt();
        int D = cin.nextInt();

        int total_nodes = n * MAX_TIME + 2;
        MCMF solver = new MCMF(total_nodes);
        int source_id = n * MAX_TIME;
        int sink_id = n * MAX_TIME + 1;

        for (int t = 0; t < MAX_TIME; ++t) {
            solver.addEdge(t, sink_id, k, C * t);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            int x = cin.nextInt();
            x--;
            solver.addEdge(source_id, x * MAX_TIME, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int t = 1; t < MAX_TIME; ++t) {
                solver.addEdge(i * MAX_TIME + t - 1, i * MAX_TIME + t, k, 0);
            }
        }

        while (m-- > 0) {
            int u = cin.nextInt();
            int v = cin.nextInt();
            u--;
            v--;

            for (int t = 1; t < MAX_TIME; ++t) {
                int a = u * MAX_TIME + t - 1;
                int b = v * MAX_TIME + t;
                int c = v * MAX_TIME + t - 1;
                int d = u * MAX_TIME + t;

                for (int i = 1, cc = D; i <= k; ++i, cc += 2 * D) {
                    solver.addEdge(a, b, 1, cc);
                    solver.addEdge(c, d, 1, cc);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] result = solver.getMinCostFlow(source_id, sink_id);
        System.out.println(result[1]);
    }
}
